title: Design System: Asaph Felix — The Woven Night

display.purpose: The name in the first viewport and the hero's registration figures. Tracked uppercase Jost 300.

headline.purpose: The title that opens each band. Tracked uppercase, weight 300.

title.purpose: Tracked uppercase numerals along the hero's bottom hairline.

body.purpose: The claim and all prose; held to a 5-of-12 column or a 36rem measure.

label.purpose: Field labels, data captions, country names. Names a thing; never a kicker above a heading.

action.purpose: Every button and call to action.

motion.name: ease-woven
motion.purpose: The single easing for reveals, the shuttle, gauge fills and header entry.

motion.name: in-view-margin
motion.purpose: Shared IntersectionObserver margin for every scroll reveal. Vertical only: a four-sided shorthand shrinks the detection box horizontally and silently kills reveals near the edges on a 390px phone.

motion.name: shuttle
motion.purpose: An amber hairline crossing a band on entry; the cloth carries the state instead of added chrome.

motion.name: selvedge-thread
motion.purpose: The left rail's amber fill is the real reading position.

motion.name: gauge-stagger
motion.purpose: The eight gauges fill left to right so the row reads as one sweep.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Every animated component gates on it and renders its settled end state.

worlds.name: Warm Editorial Light
worlds.status: incumbent, still in service; deliberately not merged or removed

components.name: Register Band
components.description: The system's container: a full-bleed band opened by a 1px hairline, with the weave field fading out under the seam and the amber shuttle across the top. Replaces the card everywhere.
components.html:
Des projets réels

De l’analyse de données à l’application mobile citoyenne, chaque projet part d’un problème concret.
components.css: .ds-band { position: relative; border-top: 1px solid oklch(0.33 0.055 255); padding: 80px 20px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.96 0.005 250); font-family: var(--font-geo), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-band-weave { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 0; height: 160px; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.7; background-image: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, oklch(0.96 0.005 250 / 0.16) 1px, transparent 1.7px), linear-gradient(to right, oklch(0.96 0.005 250 / 0.045) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(to bottom, oklch(0.96 0.005 250 / 0.045) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 22px 22px; background-position: center center; mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, black, transparent); -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, black, transparent); } .ds-band-shuttle { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; height: 1px; width: 100%; background: oklch(0.72 0.17 45); transform-origin: left; animation: ds-shuttle 1.1s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) both; } @keyframes ds-shuttle { from { transform: scaleX(0); } to { transform: scaleX(1); } } .ds-band-title { position: relative; margin: 0; font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3.6vw, 2.7rem); font-weight: 300; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.045em; line-height: 1.02; } .ds-band-body { position: relative; margin: 16px 0 0; max-width: 36rem; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.625; color: oklch(0.7 0.035 250); }

components.name: Selvedge
components.description: The cloth's finished left edge: a fixed 56px rail closed by a hairline, whose centred amber thread's filled length is the real scroll position, with vertical tracked caps at the foot.
components.css: .ds-selvedge { position: relative; width: 56px; height: 320px; border-right: 1px solid oklch(0.33 0.055 255); font-family: var(--font-geo), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-selvedge-track { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 50%; width: 1px; transform: translateX(-50%); background: oklch(0.33 0.055 255 / 0.7); } .ds-selvedge-thread { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 50%; width: 1px; transform: translateX(-50%) scaleY(0.42); transform-origin: top; background: oklch(0.72 0.17 45); } .ds-selvedge-label { position: absolute; bottom: 32px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); writing-mode: vertical-rl; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.4em; color: oklch(0.7 0.035 250); }

components.css: .ds-gauge-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 10px; font-family: var(--font-geo), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-gauge { display: flex; flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 0; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; } .ds-gauge-value { margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 9.5px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: oklch(0.7 0.035 250 / 0.7); } .ds-gauge-value-subject { color: oklch(0.72 0.17 45); } .ds-gauge-value-anomaly { color: oklch(0.7 0.18 25); } .ds-gauge-face { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; width: 100%; height: 112px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.33 0.055 255); background: oklch(0.26 0.05 255 / 0.3); } .ds-gauge-fill { display: block; width: 100%; height: 60%; background: oklch(0.7 0.035 250 / 0.45); transform-origin: bottom; } .ds-gauge-fill-subject { height: 45%; background: oklch(0.72 0.17 45); } .ds-gauge-fill-anomaly { height: 18%; background: oklch(0.62 0.2 25); } .ds-gauge-name { margin-top: 8px; writing-mode: vertical-rl; font-size: 9px; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.18em; color: oklch(0.7 0.035 250); }

components.name: Night Plate
components.description: How any light-born image or embed joins the night: dimmed and desaturated, washed with indigo in color blend mode, with the same weave passing over it.
components.css: .ds-plate { position: relative; isolation: isolate; margin: 0; width: 280px; aspect-ratio: 1; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid oklch(0.33 0.055 255); border-radius: 0; background: oklch(0.26 0.05 255); } .ds-plate-img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; filter: brightness(0.82) contrast(1.04) saturate(0.85); } .ds-plate::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; background: oklch(0.34 0.07 258); mix-blend-mode: color; opacity: 0.55; } .ds-plate-weave { position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0.6; mix-blend-mode: overlay; background-image: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, oklch(0.96 0.005 250 / 0.16) 1px, transparent 1.7px), linear-gradient(to right, oklch(0.96 0.005 250 / 0.045) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(to bottom, oklch(0.96 0.005 250 / 0.045) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 22px 22px; background-position: center center; }

narrative.overview:
The home page is a single piece of cloth seen at night. A deep indigo ground carries a regular matrix of small light points held between warp and weft hairlines, and the page's content is laid into that cloth as registers — full-bleed horizontal bands stacked and separated by a hairline — rather than dropped onto it as cards. One saturated colour crosses the whole page: an amber-coral weft that marks the primary action and the one subject of the data. Everything else is the cloth and its own light.

The system is quiet and orthogonal. Corners are square because a cloth's geometry is orthogonal; grouping comes from space and a hairline, not from a bordered box; one geometric face carries both the giant tracked display and the running text, so the night reads as its own world rather than as the light site repainted. Imagery is not exempt: photographs and embedded dashboards are cooled and dimmed into the ground so nothing punches a lit hole through the weave.

The page deliberately refuses the category default it would otherwise land on — a dark hero with one neon accent followed by a grid of equal cards. It also refuses a second type family, a second saturated colour, and added chrome for state: state is signalled by the cloth itself changing.
keyCharacteristics: Indigo night ground (#07101C) with hairline structure, no filled surfaces
One accent, amber-coral, on the primary action only; red reserved for one anomalous datum
Square corners throughout (--radius: 0); rounded-full survives only for genuine pills
One family, Jost, for display and body alike; display is tracked uppercase
Bands, not cards: a band opens with a 1px top hairline and nothing else
One texture primitive, the weave field, at a single 22px pitch everywhere

rules.name: The One Weft Rule
rules.body: One saturated colour on the page. Amber marks the primary action and the data's subject; anything else that wants colour gets lightness instead. Brand-coloured logos enter monochrome and recover their colour only on hover, where brand identity is the actual information.

rules.name: The Reserved Red Rule
rules.body: Red is not an accent, a state colour, or an error colour. It belongs to the one anomalous data value and is spent nowhere else. If a second red appears on a screen, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Joined Imagery Rule
rules.body: Any light-born raster or embed on the night ground goes through the plate treatment — brightness(0.82) contrast(1.04) saturate(0.85) plus the plate wash at 0.55 in mix-blend-mode: color. Imagery joins the cloth; it is never pasted over it.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Display and running text are the same family. If a screen needs a second font to make a distinction, it needs tracking, weight or case instead.

rules.name: The Tracked Caps Rule
rules.body: Everything above body scale is uppercase and positively tracked (+0.045em at register scale, +0.08em at display). The light world's phrase-case editorial serif and its one-word italic emphasis are explicitly neutralised in the night — a tracked italic reads as a leaning duplicate, not as emphasis.

rules.name: The Legible Floor Rule
rules.body: Text on the night ground is measured, not assumed: body 7.5:1, navigation 17.7:1, the smallest tag 6.18:1, text on the amber button 7.39:1, form placeholders 6.5:1. Nothing ships below the smallest of these.

rules.name: The Band Rule
rules.body: A section is a full-bleed band opened by a 1px top hairline. Bands do not nest, do not indent, and do not get their own background.

rules.name: The Flat Cloth Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts. If an element needs to separate from its neighbour, it gets a hairline, space, or a lightness step — never a shadow and never a glow.

dos: Do open a new section as a band: 1px top hairline, transparent ground, 80/112/128px vertical rhythm, 56px left inset.
Do spend amber on the primary action and on the one thing the data is about — nothing else.
Do keep every corner square; reach for rounded-full only when the element is a genuine pill.
Do set anything above body scale in tracked uppercase Jost at weight 300.
Do run any photograph, screenshot or embed through the plate treatment before it touches the night ground.
Do draw structure with 1px hairlines and space.
Do route every scroll-triggered animation through the shared IN_VIEW_MARGIN and the reduced-motion hook.
Do keep the weave field masked and behind the text it sits under.
donts: Don't introduce a second saturated colour, or spend red on anything but the single anomalous value.
Don't wrap content in a filled, bordered, rounded card — the night groups by hairline and space.
Don't add a second type family; distinctions come from case, tracking and weight.
Don't signal state with added chrome (badges, glows, coloured outlines) when the cloth itself can carry it.
Don't add shadows or lift; the system casts nothing.
Don't measure the same quantity twice — the selvedge already reports reading position.
Don't hard-code a radius or a colour past the tokens; the night redefines them at the wrapper and literal values escape it.
Don't carry the night's tokens onto the case study route, which is still served by the light editorial world.
gaps: The weave carries no quantity: the 22px pitch is fixed everywhere rather than varying with density.
The shuttle does not light the points it crosses.
The portrait has no aperture resolving out of the field.
